Materializes the exact seven decisions reviewed in ; new Current semantic versioned extension and successor Current FC execution policy. Does **not** authorize FC-01 P31/P32 or modify GitHub source/state/gates. **No product/semantic decision outside D1–D7 is accepted.** ## 0. Accepted record identity and trusted basis - Accepted governing inputs: ; product/schema/operation designs and ; exact repo baseline `Mostorm-Labs/axiom@2942c63b375366ed977b834aa0a48fe2fb551c6e`. - Product request: five creation presets, pale preview, cross-object alignment, Fill/Stroke controls, selected-object commands, Debug UI. **User expressly removed selected-Shape-kind conversion**; this exclusion is part of accepted product scope. - New Authority IDs: `fc01-shape-triangle-semantic-v0.1` (new semantic versioned scope), `fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.2` (supersedes v0.1 for existing FC execution scope). Previously frozen V1 numeric registries and v1 Operation vocab remain unchanged. - **Notion vs repo-local difference is explicit**: P23 establishes the Notion Authority, but `.aegis/authorities.json` on the accepted base still contains Current `fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.1`. Its replacement and new versioned semantic binding require a separate source-controlled transition, official Aegis v0.6 `transition/validate/recompute/check`, immutable historical Gate/Integration/Evidence preservation and independent review before P31. ## 1. P23 formal decisions: all seven reviewed
Decision / P21 ref P23 formal acceptance Immutable non-claims and next verified owner
D1 / P21-F01 Shape registry ACCEPT new exact semantic triple `(Shape=1, kind_version=2, shape_kind=3)` only, isosceles upright Triangle W/H; new separately versioned scope/registry. V1 `(Shape1/1,shapeKind1/2)` unchanged; `(Shape1/1,3)` still reject SH-G06. P12 registry v2 successor, no overwrite frozen V1.
D2 / P21-F02 Operation ACCEPT reuse `Operation.schema_version=1, payload_version=1` with existing 15 mutation types and joint Shape/2 validation. No new Op, no `SetShapeKind`, no payload2 concession for Triangle, existing Brush-v2 payload2 unaffected; P13/P14–P17 strict ingress.
D3 / P21-F03 Snapshot/replay ACCEPT minimum `Snapshot.schema_version=2` for Triangle on capable client. Snapshot1+Triangle reject; Snapshot2 label alone insufficient. Existing snapshot v1/v2 legacy/Brush unaffected; old clients fail closed; typed replay and bootstrap must use whole-operation/version validation.
D4 / P21-F04 Resize ACCEPT **single Operation modes**: handle SetTransforms vs numeric base W/H SetObjectSize. No coupled Size+Transform atomic resize in FC-01, no fake UndoIntent atomicity; stroke rendering & Inspector semantics P14–P17.
D5 / P21-F05 History/Lock ACCEPT minimum local FC-01 undo/redo and inverse-preimage/conflict guard in existing EditorHistory; apply Field Registry `locked` as editor-control behavior. No global semantic wire-parser mutation ban; FC-10 keeps general cross-object History/Clipboard; P14–P17 implementation and P20 tests required.
D6 / P21-F06 FC stage scope ACCEPT FC-01 basic FreePoint Straight Line/Arrow + minimal hit; creation-time far-axis center/edge Snap and guides, consuming G4.6 transient baseline. FC-06 retains attached anchors/routing/endpoints; FC-07 retains full align/distribute/layout; exact FC01 DEV oracle necessary.
D7 / P21-F07 Mixed clients ACCEPT capable writer/reader requirements and refusal or proven lossless read-only handling for clients lacking Shape/2. No unknown-Shape writer, legacy partial replay, lossy downgrade or implicit Snapshot2 capability; P17 host contract + P20 independent proof.
## 2. Authority topology / supersession identity
Authority scope Prior/current state before P23 P23 materialized result
`semantic:axiom/shape-content-version2-triangle` No old Current new-tuple authority; V1 ShapeKind/ObjectKind frozen for V1. New CURRENT for additive **new version**; historical V1 stays authoritative for Shape/1.
`execution:FC/feature-completion` `fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.1` CURRENT, physically also repo-local Current at `2942c63b…`. New FC Feature Completion Track Execution Authority v0.2 — CURRENT / FC-01 P23 Accepted CURRENT; previous is SUPERSEDED/HISTORICAL in Notion; repo-local transition pending.
`gate:G2`,`capability:G3`,`capability:G4` Existing Current/Superseded `.aegis` entries and all old P34 decisions. **Unchanged.** Never claim original PX0/G4.6/G4.7 P34 PASS or FC-13 PHYS PASS.
Master/G5/G6 G0–G9 Master Current with earlier FC line, G5 predecessor, G6 split. Remain Current in own scope; FC v0.2 only narrows FC-01 early slice. No broad Master/G5/G6 supersession this round.
- FC v0.1 is not deleted; historic P10/P11/P12/P13/P21 child pages remain under it and retain their original proposed/at-the-time statuses. A dated P23 note may point to this accepted successor, **not** rewrite historic proposal wording as if it were Current on its creation date. - Released `ShapeKind Registry V1`, `ObjectKind Registry V1`, `Field Registry V1`, Protobuf descriptor/field numbers, 15 Operations, original SH-G01..18 (SH-G06 REJECT), existing Brush payload2 exception and Connector V1 must not be overwritten. New Shape/2 semantics are scoped to an additive version tuple. ## 3. Five-axis acceptance and specific negative constraints - **Product:** FC-01 must deliver Rectangle/Ellipse/Triangle and independent FreePoint Line/Arrow creation, basic Snap/Guides, appearance + selected-object essential commands. No selected Shape type conversion, no Clipboard or rich Text as FC-01 claim. - **Semantic:** Shape/2 triple and original schema1/payload1 carrier are compatible **subject to explicit v2-aware admission**; Snapshot2 minimum, no kind alias or new operation, no combined Resize mutation; old Shape/1 semantics immutable. - **Architecture:** G4.4/G4.6 continue owning input/gesture/selection/overlay, Semantic Kernel owns canonical objects/operations, existing EditorHistory handles undo intent, Runtime Facade/Debug UI are shared clients. FC-06/07 early slices are time-shifted, not copied to second owners. - **Implementation:** existing repo valid v0.6 state reflects former Current FC Authority. This P23 issues no repo push, canonical change, code, validator or test. P14–P17 must design version-aware validators, History/lock/editor controls, proper Snap and Connector hit/scene paths and cross-client refusal. - **Verification:** FC-01 P20 must freeze independently testable oracles for old/new tuples, bytes, Snapshot/replay, mixed-client guard, separate resized local-vs-view geometry, gesture cancellation, Snap candidates, basic Connector and undo/redo. FC-N-DEV can never claim original PX0/G4.6/G4.7 PHYS or hosted provider PASS; FC-13 preserves their original subject/build profiles. ## 4. Materialization and lifecycle gates after P23 - **P23 Notion acceptance status:** `ACCEPTED_NOTION_WITH_REPO_LOCAL_MATERIALIZATION_PENDING`. This is a **real Authority acceptance**, not another review proposal, but it is **not a repo-local Current binding** yet. - **Next legal design stages:** FC-01 P14 System Architecture → P15 Module Design → P16 Runtime Data Flow → P17 Platform/Facade Contract → P18 if budgets needed → P20 independent Verification; these stages consume exact accepted semantic/execution URLs. - **Mandatory pre-P31 reconciliation:** source-controlled controlled Aegis v0.6 Authority successor transition: supersede `fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.1` / append `fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.2`; separately bind `fc01-shape-triangle-semantic-v0.1` without duplicating Current scopes. Recompute State deterministically; prove existing G2/G3/G4 Authority history and 25 original Gate Decisions, 29 Integrations, 34 Evidence exact preservation (unless separate authorized successor changed those counts); complete independent control/Gate review before making FC-01 P31 authoritative. - **P31/P32:** NOT_AUTHORIZED until materialized successor identity, P14–P17 accepted contracts and FC01 P20 frozen evidence obligations converge. Codex cannot treat this Notion approval as a code execution package. No P34 DEV, FC13 physical, historical PX0/G4 PASS or G5 gate is issued. ## 5. Accepted terminal metadata ```yaml task_id: FC-01 stage: P23 stage_owner: aegis-governance status: ACCEPTED_NOTION_WITH_REPO_LOCAL_MATERIALIZATION_PENDING p21_review: COMPLETE accepted_decisions: [D1,D2,D3,D4,D5,D6,D7] semantic_current_id: fc01-shape-triangle-semantic-v0.1 fc_execution_current_id: fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.2 fc_execution_superseded_id: fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.1 repository: provider: github full_name: Mostorm-Labs/axiom exact_dev_ancestor: 2942c63b375366ed977b834aa0a48fe2fb551c6e repo_current_fc_authority: fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.1 repo_local_successor_status: PENDING_SEPARATE_EXECUTION_AND_REVIEW old_gates_and_physical_status: UNCHANGED new_operation_kinds: 0 shape_kind_conversion: FORBIDDEN next_design_stage: P14 fc01_p31_p32: NOT_AUTHORIZED ``` - **No direct P14/P20 Primary stage execution occurs in this P23 review**.
